name: Financial Information Baseline
description: Financial data hygiene: redacts credit card numbers and IBAN codes out of prompts, tool inputs, and tool outputs, requires a written reason for likely US bank account numbers, and flags Bitcoin wallet addresses. The bank-account rule requires a nearby context keyword (account/routing number) to hold down false positives on plain digit strings, and still uses justify rather than request_access because RE2 has no lookaround to assert the keyword more strictly — see rule description before enabling in a high-noise environment.

rules.name: Redact credit card numbers and IBAN codes
rules.description: Scans user prompts, tool call inputs, and tool outputs for credit card numbers and International Bank Account Numbers. Redacts matches and allows execution to proceed with the sanitised data.

rules.name: Require justification for likely US bank account or routing numbers
rules.description: Matches an 8-17 digit number immediately preceded by a bank/routing/account keyword, to avoid firing on bare digit strings (order IDs, phone numbers, invoice numbers). Requires a written reason before the content proceeds — kept at justify rather than request_access because the pattern is still a heuristic (RE2 has no lookaround, so the keyword is captured inline rather than asserted) and shouldn't create an admin-approval bottleneck on false positives.

rules.name: Warn on Bitcoin wallet addresses
rules.description: Detects legacy (P2PKH/P2SH) and bech32 Bitcoin address formats. Logs a warning without blocking.
